leads.company: Brigade Group — Arcadia at Brigade Cornerstone Utopia
leads.trigger: Opened 6-screen, 949-seat PVR INOX at Arcadia (~2.5 lakh sq ft retail, Varthur Rd/Whitefield) on 1 Sep 2026; COO Retail positions it as 'everyday retail + experiential offerings' — entertainment line-up still being built
leads.pitch_angle: Brigade already hosts our live zone at Orion Mall — extend the proven Orion attraction mix to Arcadia to convert new cinema footfall into dwell and spend
leads.notes: 2026-10-08: PVR INOX opened at Arcadia, 6 audis/949 seats/~42,000 sq ft; existing tenants F&B-heavy (Third Wave, Chaayos, GigaEats food court, McDonald's) — no FEC listed (https://www.constructionweekonline.in/projects-tenders/brigade-group-opens-pvr-inox-cinemas-at-brigade-cornerstone-utopia). Brigade owns Orion Malls where Circuit's own zone runs.

leads.pitch_angle: Fit-out stage for six new centres: add headset-free Mixed Reality, full-motion Car Sim and an Escape Room as anchors that rides/arcade don't cover — supplied outright, serviced from Bengaluru
leads.notes: 2026-10-08: LOI ~Sept 2026 per Amusements & Attractions (URL above); company LinkedIn says Nexus Fiza Mangalore outlet 'coming soon' (https://in.linkedin.com/company/playaza). Mall: Fiza by Nexus, 0.7 msf (https://www.nexusselecttrust.com/nexus-fiza). No named DM found — UNVERIFIED; find Playaza BD/projects head.
